name: Deck Builder Monroe
headline: Decks built for Louisiana summers.
intro: Pressure-treated, cedar, and composite decks designed around heat, humidity, and afternoon storms, built by a local crew in Monroe and West Monroe.
sectionHeadline: A deck that survives its first summer.
about: North Louisiana is hard on outdoor wood. Standing humidity, long stretches above ninety degrees, and heavy spring rain will find every shortcut in a deck's framing. We build for that: proper footings below the frost line, joists spaced and flashed so water drains instead of sitting, hardware rated for treated lumber, and fasteners that will not bleed rust down your boards after one season. The result costs a little more up front and holds its shape for years longer.

services.title: Custom Wood Decks
services.description: Pressure-treated pine and cedar decks built to your yard and grade, including multi-level layouts, stairs, and railing that meets code.

services.title: Composite Decking
services.description: Low-maintenance composite and PVC boards that will not splinter, warp, or need sanding and staining every other spring.

services.title: Deck Repair and Restoration
services.description: Board and joist replacement, footing and post repair, railing upgrades, and cleaning and re-sealing for decks worth saving.

services.title: Covered Porches and Pergolas
services.description: Roofed porches, pergolas, and screened enclosures so the space is usable in August and through mosquito season.

ctaCopy: Tell us the size of the space, how you want to use it, and whether you are building new or repairing what is there. We will walk you through material options and what each one costs to keep up.
footerLine: Custom decks, covered porches, and deck repair in Monroe, Louisiana.
